description: Did a Keeta payment settle? Who paid whom, how much, and the network fee when the ledger shows one. Add to, amountBase and asset to check a receipt. Not a spendable receipt. Returns the x402 payment quote for this read (price, network, asset, pay-to, and the exact URL). It does not return data. To buy, GET the returned URL over HTTP and pay with x402; check get_x402_health first.

to.description: Optional address starting keeta_ that should have been paid
